look_here_first: LOOK FIRST AT A NARROW, HAIRLESS LEAF and one TINY flower-like cyathium at the DISTAL NODE. E. golondrina is a prostrate annual with opposite narrow oblong leaves 5–11.5 × 1–4 mm, UNEQUAL bases, ENTIRE edges (no teeth) and mostly just the midvein showing. Inspect a cyathium with 10–20× magnification: four deeply concave, round RED–PURPLE glands and conspicuous WHITE crescent/fan-shaped appendages. Fruit is smooth, three-lobed and glabrous. The decisive close match is E. simulans: it has more ELLIPTIC gland shapes and normally lacks the white appendages, plus slightly larger 1.5–2 mm seeds. E. golondrina seed 1.3–1.5 mm, barely transversely ridged; seed and stipules require macro. Not an ordinary Hays County encounter plant: documented chiefly southwestern TX Rio Grande region. The current field photo shows narrow hairless leaves and tiny distal cyathia, but NOT microscopic mature seed ridges.

key_traits.label: Family pattern
key_traits.text: Euphorbiaceae; Euphorbia sect. Anisophyllum: opposite leaves, tiny specialized cyathia (not ordinary flowers), milky latex, three-lobed capsular fruit.

key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Annual with slender taproot. Prostrate slender stems 5–35 cm long, glabrous; in dry gravelly or sandy Rio Grande desert habitats. Do not call any single cropped shoot a whole rooted habit.

key_traits.label: Leaves
key_traits.text: Opposite, oblong to ovate-oblong or narrowly elliptic-oblong, 5–11.5 × 1–4 mm; bases asymmetric/cuneate-to-rounded, tip blunt, MARGINS ENTIRE sometimes rolled under when dried; glabrous, prominent midvein only.

key_traits.label: Stem and hairs
key_traits.text: Stems, petioles, blades, involucres, capsules glabrous. Red-tinged stems are possible but not decisive.

key_traits.label: Stipules
key_traits.text: Distinct, slender awl-shaped (SUBULATE) 0.5–0.8 mm, hairless; microscopic true nodal attachment required to verify rather than an incidental hair.

key_traits.label: Cyathium
key_traits.text: Usually solitary at distal nodes; short peduncle 0.9–1.5 mm. Involucre turbinate and hairless 0.9–1.5 × 0.8–1.3 mm; 4 (occasionally rudimentary) DEEPLY CONCAVE SUBCIRCULAR glands, red–purple 0.3–0.4 mm with WHITE crescent to small fan-shaped appendages roughly 0.1–0.3 × 0.5–0.8 mm.

key_traits.label: Capsule
key_traits.text: Broadly ovoid 1.7–2 × 1.5–1.6 mm, GLABROUS. Do not confuse smooth capsule lobes with the brightly colored glands on separate cyathia.

key_traits.label: Seed
key_traits.text: Narrow pyramidal-ovoid, sharply 4-angled in cross section; 1.3–1.5 × 0.6–0.7 mm, very weak/faint transverse ribs or wrinkles.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: prostrate glabrous slender branches (5–35 cm) with tiny opposite entire-edged leaves

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: small oblong leaves 5–11.5 × 1–4 mm, only midvein prominent, asymmetric bases

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: solitary cyathia at distal nodes, round deeply cupped crimson-purple glands with clear white crescent-shaped appendages

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: 1.3–1.5 mm mature 4-angled seeds with weak transverse ridges
